events.continuity_hook: Starts the next client-site planning thread after the Portland expo itinerary is already booked.
events.interaction_goal: Build a flight, rental-car, and hotel shortlist that protects the Tuesday safety briefing while leaving room for the possible Wednesday controls review.
events.scenario_brief: A Columbia Basin water district asks Jonah to come in for a nitrate analyzer skid startup, with a Tuesday 7:00 a.m. safety briefing and a tentative Wednesday afternoon SCADA acceptance walk-through if the electrician finishes terminations. He needs Monday Bay Area-to-Pasco options compared with a Spokane arrival plus a longer drive, including rental-car pickup timing, an equipment crate check, and enough rest before the early plant access window. Hotel options should focus on well-reviewed Richland or Kennewick properties with parking, practical dinner access, and room basics that support early site days; unresolved items are whether the crate clears receiving Monday and whether the Wednesday controls review stays on the calendar.

events.continuity_hook: Refines the Columbia Basin startup plan once freight status is clear and the controls review moves to Thursday.
events.interaction_goal: Choose the better outbound airport plan, verify the hotel direction, and identify a Thursday return window that does not rush the SCADA walk-through.
events.scenario_brief: The equipment crate is confirmed for Monday receiving, but the electrician moves the SCADA acceptance walk-through to Thursday morning and asks Jonah to keep Wednesday open for calibration data. He wants to narrow between a Monday afternoon one-stop into Pasco with a comfortable connection and a later nonstop into Spokane that avoids the connection but adds a nighttime drive across the basin. The Richland hotel remains the stronger operational fit if breakfast timing, parking, in-room coffee, a mini-fridge, and nearby dinner choices are confirmed; the remaining decision is whether Thursday return travel can work after the new acceptance window.

events.continuity_hook: Moves the Columbia Basin utility visit from comparison to booked itinerary after the Thursday acceptance time settles.
events.interaction_goal: Finalize flights, rental car, hotel reservation, room notes, seat choices, and the Tuesday-through-Thursday site schedule.
events.scenario_brief: The SCADA acceptance walk-through is locked for Thursday 8:30 to 10:30 a.m., and the plant confirms Jonah can inspect the crate Monday evening through the contractor trailer. He books the Monday afternoon one-stop into Pasco because it avoids the late Spokane drive, reserves a compact SUV, and chooses the well-rated Richland hotel with parking, breakfast, nearby restaurants, and room notes for a coffee maker and mini-fridge. The return is set for Thursday mid-afternoon with one comfortable connection back to the Bay Area, and window seats are selected where available.

events.continuity_hook: Shifts from work travel back to a personal weekend once the Columbia Basin trip is booked.
events.interaction_goal: Create a concise flight, hotel, and rental-car comparison for a Friday-to-Sunday or Friday-to-Monday Santa Fe weekend.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah and his spouse want a late-spring long weekend in Santa Fe after the utility startup stretch, with Friday travel from the Bay Area and a Sunday or Monday return depending on her time off. They want to compare a one-stop flight into Santa Fe against an Albuquerque nonstop with the drive north, plus look at well-reviewed hotels near the Plaza or Railyard with walkable dinner options, parking, and a quiet room. The unresolved pieces are whether Monday is available, whether they want a rental car for a day trip beyond the airport transfer, and how much extra the easier Santa Fe airport is worth.

events.continuity_hook: Finalizes the Santa Fe weekend after the return date, airport choice, and hotel availability are confirmed.
events.interaction_goal: Book the flights, hotel, and rental car, add the quiet-room note, select adjacent seats, and summarize the Friday arrival and Monday return timing.
events.scenario_brief: Jonah's spouse confirms Monday off, and the better-rated Plaza-area hotel still has a refundable quiet king room available. They choose the Albuquerque nonstop over the Santa Fe one-stop because the schedule is cleaner and the fare gap is meaningful, add a compact rental car for the airport drive and one possible day trip, and set the Monday return after checkout rather than taking an early flight. Seat selection prioritizes sitting together, with a window only if it does not split them up.

events.continuity_hook: Begins a new distributor-training episode after the personal Santa Fe weekend is settled and the next work request lands.
events.interaction_goal: Build an initial flight, rental-car, and hotel comparison around the Monday freight check, Tuesday plant access, Wednesday training session, and possible Thursday extension.
events.scenario_brief: A distributor near Nashville asks Jonah to support a two-day controls training tied to a brewery wastewater pretreatment upgrade, with a Tuesday 8:00 a.m. plant walk-through in Smyrna and a Wednesday lunch-and-learn at the branch. The demo case is supposed to arrive Monday afternoon, so he needs Monday Bay Area-to-Nashville flight options that leave enough time for rental-car pickup, a freight check, and hotel check-in before the early start. Hotel options should compare staying near the branch versus closer to the plant, with attention to guest ratings, parking, breakfast timing, nearby dinner options, and whether the room has a coffee maker and mini-fridge; the open issue is whether the brewery adds a Thursday morning sanitation audit that would change the return plan.
